== Summary ==
The red carpet, gold-foil decorations and streamers his friends laid out to welcome [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] home as [[2018 World Championship]] champion, with the decorated front door behind.

* '''Event:''' [[2018 World Championship]] (homecoming)
* '''Date posted:''' 2018-10-13
* '''Image:''' native forum attachment, 3024×4032, EXIF orientation applied; the doorbell name plate and house number are blurred for privacy.

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1224616#p1224616 post 1224616] in topic 70815 ("Safely back home"), by Death Star ([[Bastian Winkelhaus]]), 13 October 2018. He wrote that this was the reception his friends gave him on getting home from the [[2018 World Championship]]: friends "who have no idea what SWCCG actually is, but who are seemingly very proud of me". Original attachment name: D56DD428-7C0B-483C-86D1-AF1BA982296E.jpeg; forum attachment id 7524. Preserved copy: pending (#1310).
* '''Posted by:''' Death Star (Bastian Winkelhaus)
